connectorUiConfig.title: FullHunt Attack Surface Alerts
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [FullHunt](https://fullhunt.io) Attack Surface Alerts data connector ingests attack surface change and exposure alerts (new subdomains, newly exposed ports, DNS and certificate changes, discovered vulnerabilities) from the [FullHunt Enterprise API](https://docs.fullhunt.io) into Microsoft Sentinel. The data connector is built on the Microsoft Sentinel Codeless Connector Framework.

sampleQueries.query:
FullHuntAlerts_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlertId
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 10

sampleQueries.description: FullHunt alerts by type over the last 7 days
sampleQueries.query:
FullHuntAlerts_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlertId
| summarize Alerts = count() by AlertType

dataTypes.name: FullHuntAlerts_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
FullHuntAlerts_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and Write permissions are required.

customs.name: FullHunt Enterprise API key
customs.description: A FullHunt Enterprise account and its API key are required. See the [FullHunt authentication documentation](https://docs.fullhunt.io/authentication).

instructionSteps.title: Connect FullHunt to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description: Copy your API key from your [FullHunt profile settings](https://fullhunt.io/user/settings/), then enter it below and select **Connect**. The connector polls FullHunt every 5 minutes for new alerts.
